verdict.rationale: Canny's native integrations send feedback items to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana, link them to issues and sync statuses. Its MCP server brings Canny data into Cursor or Claude so a developer can draft PRDs from requests and build the features. But the item Canny hands off is a feedback post, not an approved product specification, and any PRD is drafted by the user's LLM rather than managed by Canny. Missing for 10: a first-party specification/PRD artifact with an approval state, a documented flow for pulling an approved spec into implementation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull an approved product specification into the delivery workflow to start implementation
